name: Modern Warfare 2023 Music Pack
teaser: Adds in Music from second MW game.
description_html:
WARNING: DUE TO GOOGLE DRIVE DELETING FILES WHEN UNZIPPED DOWNLOAD BOBBY’s MUSIC PLAYER FIRST AND THEN THIS MOD. MOVE ONLY THE AUDIO FILES NOT THE DLL. ALT SOLUTION: Download the ZIP files from my link in Bobby’s Mod Page and then unzip them to a folder or desktop

Mod adds in the OST from the 2nd Modern Warfare game. The third game is absolute dogshit so I won’t be making a pack for that unless asked for by chatters or requested.

Install Instructions: refresher for people: Drag your BepinEx flder into your SPT directory ie root folder.
